subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The grandson understood that tools can carry memory.”?
options: A newer tool may be easier, but an old one can connect hands across generations.
It can carry memory, anger, hope, and collective strength across generations.
Some old things do not sound perfect, but they carry voices that new things cannot."
It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.
